create_image_decoder: create an ImageDecoder instance with a given input dimension and output channels
run_image_decoder_forward: run a forward pass through the ImageDecoder on a 4D tensor of shape B C H W
run_image_decoder_temporal: run a forward pass through the ImageDecoder on a 5D tensor of shape B C T H W
review_image_decoder_init: review the ImageDecoder constructor to understand how scale_factor and shift_factor are configured
refactor_image_decoder_net: refactor the ImageDecoder internal net to add more Conv2d layers or change activation functions
